market_context: October CPI came in hotter than expected, pushing Treasury yields higher; the 10-year yield is 5.02% at the snapshot and a $42 billion 10-year note auction is scheduled for 1:00 PM ET. Technology remains the weak pocket, with Nvidia facing a company-specific governance/investigation overhang while QQQ and NVDA are trading at their session lows. (apnews.com)

predictions.reasoning: SPY is sitting at its intraday low at 12:40 PM after the inflation surprise lifted rates, rather than showing a sustained midday recovery. The pending 1:00 PM ET 10-year Treasury auction adds a near-term rates risk, and the broad tape remains risk-off with VIX higher. ([apnews.com)

QQQ is down materially more than SPY and is also at its session low, consistent with higher yields pressuring long-duration technology valuations. Nvidia's idiosyncratic investigation-related pressure compounds the broader AI-stock weakness and is likely to keep a lid on a late-session Nasdaq rebound. (apnews.com)

NVDA is already down 6.87% and trading at the day's low, with fresh reporting on a shareholder lawsuit and an investigation tied to alleged export-control circumvention and CEO-related governance concerns. This is a stock-specific overhang beyond the CPI-driven market selloff, increasing the chance of continued relative underperformance into the close. (apnews.com)

DIA is holding up better than growth-heavy QQQ, but it has not escaped the broader inflation-and-yields repricing and remains below its prior close. A weak Treasury auction would reinforce the higher-rate signal late in the session and should pressure the index modestly from the current level. (apnews.com)
